indexingNote: Keep false until launch. While false, every page is marked noindex and robots.txt blocks crawlers.
featuresNote: Set to true only when real content exists. While false, those pages are left out of the build and the sitemap, and their links disappear.
privacyUpdatedNote: Change this date whenever the privacy policy text changes, and on launch day.
legalReviewNote: Set to true after a lawyer has reviewed the privacy policy and your standard agreement. See LEGAL-CHECKLIST.md.
showPlaceholdersNote: true shows gray frames where images will go (preview). Set to false at launch: every empty image slot then disappears and the site is also hidden from search while it is true.
